purpose: Independent adversarial cases for the gate suite. Authored outside the session that wrote the gates. The harness must load the evidence block below instead of evidence/ so this file runs before the real evidence exists and never depends on it.
rules_for_harness: Do not edit a case to make it pass. A failing case is a finding: report it.
expect=reject means the gates return at least the codes listed in codes[].
expect=report means the run report carries the code and the text is NOT rejected.
expect=pass means no codes at all. These catch over-blocking.
Cases with milestone=3 are skipped until app/render.py exists, then run.
